key_insight: Data4Cyber aligns OT network traffic, physical measurements, and control context to support cyberattack detection in distribution grids with solar generation and battery storage.
engineering_relevance: The dataset supports testing process-aware security monitoring for distribution management systems coordinating photovoltaics, batteries, and controllable loads.
method: Record synchronized process data, controller context, price incentives, and Modbus/TCP and MQTT traffic in a laboratory DMS.
Capture one benign baseline and six attack scenarios involving Modbus manipulation, MitM false-data injection, and MQTT price manipulation.
Provide a fixed 1-second time base and phase-resolved labels for temporally blocked, stateful-detector evaluation.
evidence_signal: Baseline evaluations show that some detectors achieve high recall through alarm saturation, while context-driven attacks require process-aware interpretation.
watch_item: Laboratory results need validation under field conditions, and detector evaluation should assess alarm burden alongside recall.
paper_title: Data4Cyber: Labeled Cyber-Physical Datasets for Distribution-Grid Management Systems Under Representative OT Attacks
